title: Split Evenly
summary: Split amount into parts whole numbers (parts is at least 1) that add up to amount and differ by at most one, larger parts first. Think of a bill in cents: 10 in 3 is [4, 3, 3], and a refund of -7 in 2 is [-3, -4].
hints: Use integer division: in several languages 7 / 2 is 3.5. The quotient is the smaller part, and the remainder says how many parts get one more.
For a negative amount the smaller part is the quotient rounded down (floor), not toward zero: -7 in 2 is -3 and -4, so you need a quotient of -4 and a remainder of 1.
If your language's division truncates, compute the floored quotient yourself and then the remainder as amount - quotient * parts, so the two always fit together.

cases.description: the remainder goes to the first parts
